content.title: WHAT YOUR {{PANCREAS}} IS QUIETLY BEGGING YOU TO EAT
facts: **Cinnamon** - just 1/2 tsp/day may help your pancreas use insulin more efficiently instead of overworking itself.
**Broccoli** - its sulforaphane content helps calm inflammation around pancreatic cells so they can keep producing enzymes smoothly.
**Cranberries** - their compounds make it harder for bacteria to cling to your bladder wall, 1 cup/day unsweetened is plenty.
**Watermelon** - mostly water, it flushes your bladder naturally and reduces irritation from concentrated urine.
**Pomegranate** - packed with iron-boosting compounds that help your spleen recycle old blood cells more efficiently.
**Spinach** - its iron and folate support the red blood cell renewal your spleen handles every single day.
**Brazil nuts** - just 2 a day supply enough selenium to support healthy thyroid hormone production.
**Seaweed** - a natural source of iodine, the core building block your thyroid needs to make hormones at all.
**Follow along** - for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Your pancreas works overtime every time you eat, and cinnamon genuinely helps lighten that load — it slows how fast sugar hits your bloodstream, so your pancreas doesn't have to scramble to release insulin all at once. Broccoli deserves more credit too: the sulforaphane in it acts almost like a shield, calming inflammation around the tiny cells responsible for enzyme production. And don't sleep on cranberries for your bladder — they contain compounds that stop bacteria from sticking to the bladder wall in the first place, which is a big part of why they're linked to fewer infections. Everyone's body is different, so listen to yours and adjust from there.
